definition.single_entry_candidate: One-day event whose official structure sheet was read in full and contains no rebuy, add-on or re-entry provision. The sheet does NOT state a one-entry cap, so this is the highest state the published sources support; ask the room for a written answer (see Questions).
definition.spend_advantage: Money buys an edge or extra entries: paid third-party membership discounts, priced subsequent buy-ins, rebuys or add-ons.
definition.multi_flight: Day 1A/1B/... flights: a player who does not reach Day 2 may buy into another starting flight (stated on the sheet), so the event is not single-entry.
definition.unverified: Row exists on the official schedule; the structure sheet has not been read, so entry rules, fee and payout timing are unknown.
definition.ratio_gtd_to_buyin: Descriptive only: published guarantee divided by the buy-in. It is not an expected value, a forecast, or an overlay.
